title: [finding] a misspelt field name in a field's `relatedListColumns`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupFilters[].field` or `dependsOn` passes every authoring door, and fails only at view or picker time
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, finding class **(c)**. `reach:` is a named real producer, measured below. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post #18917) from the review of PR #20428 (#19332 flight G1b). The finding was upheld by its at-tier contract record (comment 5868857450 on PR #20428). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens (measured on `origin/main` by code reading; the runtime effects are NOT MEASURED end to end)

Four field-level keys name other fields of the same object:
- `relatedListColumns`: `array(string.min(1))`, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1519`
- `lookupColumns`: `array(union(string, {field,…}))`, `:1591`
- `lookupFilters[].field`: `:1602`
- `dependsOn`: `array(union(string, {field,param}))`, `:1617`

Every node is a bare `z.string()`. No authoring door reads the names:
- Not the Zod parse.
- Not the publish door (`metadata-protocol` / `runtime` read none of them).
- Not `os validate`. No rule under `packages/lint/src` (non-test) reads the first three. `lookupFilters` is walked only by `filter-walk.ts` and `validate-preset-comparands.ts`, which judge values. `validate-object-field-refs.ts` owns `highlightFields` and `publicSharing.redactFields` only.

At run time, by code reading:
- A misspelt `lookupColumns` entry renders an empty column.
- A misspelt `dependsOn` name keeps the picker gated for good.
- `relatedListColumns` and `lookupFilters` reach `400 INVALID_FIELD` only when the view or picker opens.

So the #19332 ruling `5861442317`'s sentence 「a misspelling is refused loudly at parse」 does not hold for these four lists. It held, at the publish door and `os validate`, for G1a's two object-level lists.

## Reach (named real producers)

- `examples/app-showcase` authors `lookupColumns` (the object arm) and `relatedListColumns`.
- hotcrm authors `relatedListColumns` in 3 files and `dependsOn` in 4, per the #19332 analysis report `5859943900`.

## Where the fix lands (for the dispatch to confirm)

Extend the object-level field-reference family (`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`) to these four field-level lists: a name that is not a field of the owning object is refused at `os validate` / `os build`, with the object's field list as the prescription. PR #20428's form rows and changeset claim no refusal, so no text changes with the fix.

Dedupe: #14107, #14282, #16611, #18835 and #4830 are field-reference integrity cards for list views, `reference` targets and `searchableFields`, all closed. None covers these four field-level lists.

Dedupe words: `field-level field-name list reference integrity` · `relatedListColumns unknown field lint` · `lookupColumns dependsOn unknown field` · `object-field-ref field lists`
